# Code block: `jl-code-block`

Source code, coloured, with a button to copy it.

- Class `JlCodeBlock`, a molecule: `import { JlCodeBlock } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/code-block

Shows source code with light colouring for TypeScript and JSX, HTML, CSS and shell, and a button to copy
it. The colouring is a small scanner, not a parser: it is meant for snippets in docs and settings pages.

Give the code as the code property, or write it inside the element. HTML written inside is parsed by the browser,
so wrap it in a template to keep it as text.

## Use

```ts
import { JlCodeBlock } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlCodeBlock
  code="const greeting = 'Hello';
console.log(greeting);"
  heading="hello.ts"
  language="ts"
/>
```

```html
<jl-code-block
  code="const greeting = 'Hello';
console.log(greeting);"
  heading="hello.ts"
  language="ts"
></jl-code-block>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `code` (attribute `code`): `string`, default `''`. The code; without it, the element's own text.
- `language` (attribute `language`): `'text' | 'ts' | 'html' | 'css' | 'bash'`, default `'text'`. How to colour it.
- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. A file name or title over the code.
- `lineNumbers` (attribute `line-numbers`): `boolean`, default `false`. Numbers the lines.
- `wrap` (attribute `wrap`): `boolean`, default `false`. Wraps long lines instead of scrolling.
- `maxHeight` (attribute `max-height`): `string`, default `''`. A CSS height past which the code scrolls under its header, the copy button staying in view: 320px, 50vh; a number is pixels.
- `hideCopy` (attribute `hide-copy`): `boolean`, default `false`. Hides the copy button.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### TypeScript, with a file name

```html
<jl-code-block language="ts" heading="main.ts">
  import { JlButton } from '@syware/jlib';

  const save = new JlButton();
  save.label.set('Save');
  save.events.register('press', () => console.log('saved'));
  document.body.append(save);
</jl-code-block>
```

### HTML, kept in a template

```html
<jl-code-block language="html">
  <template>
    <jl-field label="Email">
      <jl-input type="email" name="email" required></jl-input>
    </jl-field>
  </template>
</jl-code-block>
```

### CSS, with line numbers

```html
<jl-code-block language="css" line-numbers>
  :root {
    --jl-accent: #7c3aed;
    --jl-accent-strong: #6d28d9;
  }
</jl-code-block>
```

### Shell

```html
<jl-code-block language="bash" code="npm install @syware/jlib @jadis/core"></jl-code-block>
```
